semiconductor_relevance: High — Shenzhen Naso Tech specializes in high-end thin-film deposition equipment essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Shenzhen Naso Tech Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures advanced thin-film deposition equipment for applications in third-generation semiconductors, photovoltaics, and lithium batteries. The company aims to lead in the advanced materials manufacturing sector by leveraging its expertise in various deposition techniques.
capabilities: Thin-film deposition equipment for silicon carbide and perovskite materials

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Shenzhen, China, focusing on R&D and production of semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
